cards.description:
A book that teaches you how to talk yourself up and package yourself for sale to a company.

You always have a price, no matter how much the thought of it might disgust you. Perhaps your wretched fate was sealed 5,000 years ago, at the moment when that person picked up the very first seashell.

nodes.name: Sea
nodes.textMorning:
The sea beside this city is rather ugly. The shore is mostly mudflats, with no sand to play on.
Still, the sea is the sea. Simply looking out at the horizon is enough to satisfy you.
nodes.textAfternoon:
The sea beside this city is rather ugly. The shore is mostly mudflats, with no sand to play on.

nodes.textSunset: The sunset by the sea is beautiful.
nodes.textNight: The sea looks frightening at night. Sometimes you feel that if you stand here too long, you may be unable to resist this vast and silent darkness.
